name: @pipeworx/mcp-countries

tools.name: search_countries
tools.description: Search for countries by name. Returns official name, capital, region, population, area, languages, currencies, flag emoji, and the country's land borders by name — so "which countries border Bolivia" is answerable directly.

query.description: Country name to search for (partial matches are supported)

tools.name: get_country_by_code
tools.description: Get country details by ISO code (e.g., "US" for United States or "FRA" for France). Returns capital, population, languages, currencies, area, and region.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country code

tools.name: countries_by_region
tools.description: List all countries in a region (e.g., "Africa", "Europe", "Asia"). Returns name, capital, population, area, and flag emoji.

region.description: Region name — one of: africa, americas, asia, europe, oceania

tools.name: countries_by_language
tools.description: Find countries where a language is spoken (e.g., "Spanish", "Mandarin"). Returns name, capital, region, population, and official language status.

tools.name: countries_by_currency
tools.description: Find countries using a currency (e.g., "EUR" for Euro, "USD" for US Dollar). Returns name, capital, region, and currency details.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-countries forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the countries pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
